name: Super Dangan Ronpa 2 Sayonara Zetsubou Gakuen
original_name: スーパーダンガンロンパ2 さよなら絶望学園
source:
Blue skies, white clouds, a glittering ocean, and a vast beach...

Hope’s Peak Academy is holding its school trip at Jabberwock Island—a tropical island famous for being a popular vacation resort. But thanks to the actions of their wicked headmaster, the students quickly realize that they are not leaving this island any time soon. Their only chance of escape is to murder one of their classmates, and survive the class trial without getting caught.

During the frantic, high-stakes class trial, you must use the evidence you gathered during your investigation, as well your classmates’ testimonies, to literally shoot down your opponent’s arguments.

Amid the heightened suspicion, encroaching madness, and emotional exhaustion, the next evolution of the class trial is about to begin.

[From [url=https://danganronpa.us/danganronpa2/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
藍天、白雲、閃耀的大海與一望無際的沙灘……

希望峰學園在著名熱帶度假勝地賈巴沃克島舉辦校外教學。然而，在邪惡校長黑白熊的操縱下，學生們很快意識到自己短期內根本無法離島。唯一的逃生方法，就是殺死一名同學，並在不被識破的情況下挺過班級審判。

在節奏緊張、賭上一切的班級審判中，你必須運用調查所得證據與同學證詞，真正「射穿」對手的論點。

猜疑不斷加深，瘋狂逐步逼近，所有人的精神都已疲憊不堪。班級審判即將迎來下一次進化。

[譯自 [url=https://danganronpa.us/danganronpa2/story.html]官方網站[/url]]
